claim.adversary: ROBUST within the tested quiescent offline Wide projection manifest contract
claim.scope: Direct selected Wide projection opens and offline full and window scans bind the child manifest to the parent's uncompressed projection entry before callbacks. Writer publication and reader preflight share ClickHouse's checked size and SipHash-128 summary.
claim.outside_scope: Compact projection children, concurrent catalog mutation, projection freshness, additional payload verification, and performance. Existing selected reader paths govern payload checks.

risk.strongest_failure: The reader accepts a locally valid child with the same physical size and different recorded hashes under an original parent manifest.
checks: Replace a valid child with an equal-size child and require a checksum mismatch before any callback.
Reject missing, compressed, and wrong-size entries and nonregular manifests. Preflight a damaged later parent for both full scans and EOF windows.

Require reciprocal stock and library reads, native ATTACH and CHECK, and a forced read plan naming the projection. Replace the stock child with the native-accepted library child in a copy and require rejection before output or publication.
risk.rollback: Revert the feature commit as a unit. The reader opens existing parts without writing to them.

verification.baseline_debug: The same-size replacement example reports one failure because no CorruptPartError is raised.
verification.opt_in_fixtures: The aggregate cohort includes six fresh W221 profiles and W177 Count parts generated by 31 successful native invocations. An older W177 assertion expected refusal of the supported Count projection. The updated example verifies the literal states and parent identity.

native.reference_source_scope: Separate shallow source checkout. MergeTreeDataPartChecksum.cpp defines the summary. MergedBlockOutputStream.cpp writes the parent entry. checkDataPart.cpp recomputes the recursive part checksums.
native.physical_observations: The stock Wide projection reads through the public APIs. Native ATTACH retains every generated file and adds invalidated_system_columns.txt. CHECK succeeds and the forced EXPLAIN names by_score. The native-accepted donor has a different child mark grid. Copying it under the original stock parent manifest fails before stdout or a destination directory.

verification.independent_check: The report binds guarded commands and raw captures to the source seal and runtime pin. The root audit checks literal RowBinary rows, the selected plan and all generated file bytes, then runs the native child replacement. Format checks cover 24 Crystal files.

refresh_when: Rerun the affected spec cohorts and both native profiles after changes to projection admission, checksum parsing or summary, selected payload binding, writer staging, harness, toolchain, or runtime. Rebuild helpers from the recorded commands and sealed inputs.
